title: Identifying Joint-Intervention Means from Menus of Partial Interventions under Private Confounding
banked_reason: Math review passed with no findings after the scoped soundness repair; the general referee graded the delivered paper subfield at 7.0 below the 7.4 field threshold and salvageable=false.
gap_reasons: The exact row-span equivalence is proved only for Model_D: finite action alphabets, mutually independent private blocks, matching-cell positivity, and the strong regime-by-regime restriction E[U_Y^r | B] = 0; it does not establish completeness for broader additive private-confounder SCMs.

The maximal-hierarchy and unique-completion results follow from the same incidence algebra, but their practical importance is supported only by one three-action example, without a substantive application, estimation theory, or weighted design analysis.
The targeted rather than exhaustive priority comparison and the narrow causal model limit the leading-journal score.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved all 12 core statements for the finite-action, standard-Borel private-block modular structural-mean class, including the row-span identification equivalence, positive full-law countermodels, all maximal identifiable hierarchies, and the unique coverage-preserving completion. A validity-gate repair narrowed positivity to observational cells and derived every intervention matching-cell probability; the replayed math referee then passed with no findings. The result was downgraded because the general referee judged the model scope and demonstrated practical reach insufficient for field tier, assigning subfield at 7.0/7.4 with no bounded lift.
tldr: For finite ordered actions with mutually independent private confounder/action-noise blocks, arbitrary nonempty standard-Borel latent and randomizer spaces, and an absolutely integrable downward-closed structural-mean hierarchy, the full joint-intervention mean is uniformly identified from observation and any menu of complete intervention laws exactly when the all-ones row lies in the rational row span of the augmented incidence matrix. A row-span certificate gives an explicit linear functional; failure gives finite categorical, strictly positive SCMs with the same supplied full laws and different targets. The same algebra enumerates every maximal identifiable hierarchy and the unique coverage-preserving completion that creates a greatest one.
gap: Existing theorems give singleton or partition sufficiency for additive private-confounder SCMs, product-ratio synthesis for factorized densities, decomposable-response aggregation, or graphical g-identification. The inspected results do not give the proposed arbitrary-overlap iff for this finite modular structural-mean class, its positive full-law converse, or its complete hierarchy frontier.
fill: Prove posterior factorization and the derived incidence expansion under the modular outcome equation; establish rational row-span completeness and the finite Bernoulli full-law lift; then enumerate maximal downsets, characterize greatest-hierarchy existence, and prove the forced coverage-preserving completion.
